ammonia.reason: Ammonia from yeast and Geotrichum amino-acid deamination raises pH to >6 by day 28.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from cow milk; no washed-rind Brevibacterium activity.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet/chymosin and Lactococcus proteinases in lactic curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; no blue methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose/lysine Maillard when heated; high moisture limits browning.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate fermentation plus milkfat lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic/hexanoic acids from native and Geotrichum lipase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 55% fat-in-dry-matter, 60% moisture and late proteolysis solubilize casein to spoonable paste.

crumbliness.reason: Lactic demineralized curd is chalky when young but proteolyzed to smooth when ripe.

firmness.reason: High moisture, acid demineralization and surface-mold proteolysis soften body to soft.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from yeast esterification of acids and ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal; short 15-28 day age limits Maillard-type notes.

melt.reason: High moisture and pH rise from 4.3 to 5.5-6 restores casein hydration and flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from Geotrichum candidum and P. camemberti white-mold lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: Stable acid-gel emulsion and small 80g format limit free-oil release.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from Lactococcus fermentation to pH 4.3 plus minor acetic acid.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; acid-demineralized casein does not align into fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No curd cooking; very low methional/dimethyl sulfide from methionine.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; slight sweetness from glycerol, lactones and low salt masking.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate from early Lactococcus/Geotrichum proteolysis, limited by short age.
